newsitem.title: CHINA: Steel Tube reverses losses in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Steel Tube reverses losses in 1996.

text.p: Shanghai Steel Tube Co Ltd reversed losses in 1996 due to improved sales and adjustments to its mix of products, according to a company published on Tuesday in the Shanghai Securities News.
The company reported a net profit of 983,000 yuan in 1996 against a loss of 42.962 million yuan in 1995 under international accounting standards, the statement said.
"We improved our management and sales after suffering losses and enlarged our sales network to cities outside Shanghai," the statement said.
"Another factor that helped profits was an adjustment to our variety of products," it said. "We increased production in high-value steel tubes, which brought more profits and greater market share."
The statement said the company imported new equipment and technology, laying the groundwork for the company to produce new, competitive products.
